jobs.title: Senior Accountant
jobs.description_text: The Role Accounting at a company like ours is not a steady-state job. We buy parts, build aircraft, and sign contracts with the government, often all in the same month. Every one of those activities has to be recorded correctly, supportable under audit, and structured so it still holds up when we're ten times bigger. We're looking for an accountant who wants to own that. You'll run the close, keep the ledger clean, and be the person who figures out the right treatment when something new shows up, which will happen often. You'll help set up the cost structures, controls, and processes the company will run on for years. This is a senior role, and we care more about how you think than how long you've been doing it. If you've built real depth early and you're ready for more ownership than your current seat allows, we want to hear from you. You'll work closely with finance leadership and partner with operations, supply chain, and our program teams. What You'll Do - Own the month-end close: journal entries, accruals, reconciliations, and the schedules that support them - Keep the general ledger accurate, timely, and something an auditor could walk through without surprises - Account for inventory as we move from prototypes to production: raw materials, WIP, finished goods, capitalization, and cost of goods sold - Help build and maintain our cost structure for government contracts, including indirect cost pools, allocation bases, rate tracking, and segregation of unallowable costs -

jobs.title: Head of Marketing
jobs.description_text: This is the one you've been waiting for You've told other people's stories. You've polished brands someone else built. You've waited for the company where you get to help create that story. This is that company. Swarm Aero is building the autonomous systems the U.S. and its allies need to deter a peer conflict: Gamera, a Group 5 autonomous aircraft, the specialized manufacturing capacity to build them at incredible scale, and Legion, our autonomy and command and control software for coordinating swarms of uncrewed systems. Our autonomy software is already running on real programs and real hardware. Now we're scaling it onto our own aircraft. We have never had a marketer. We have a mission, a team that ships, and a story that is growing and evolving everyday. You'll be the one to shape it and tell it. What you'll build - Who we are. Define the identity of Swarm Aero from the ground up: what we stand for, how we sound, how we look, and why anyone should care. When someone asks "what does Swarm do?", the answer everyone gives will be the one you wrote. - How we tell it. Turn complex autonomy and C2 technology into a story that lands with a general, a program manager, a reporter, an investor, and a senior engineer, without watering it down for any of them. - Internal comms. Make sure everyone inside Swarm knows where we're going, why it matters, and what just happened. jobs.title: Systems Safety Engineer
jobs.description_text: Swarm Aero is building large, autonomous, swarming UAS for operations at scale in contested environments. Safety isn't a checkbox for us - it's a design input. We need a System Safety Engineer who can architect safety into the design, someone who can work directly with engineering teams to mitigate hazards and ensure our aircraft fail gracefully when things go wrong. jobs.title: Structures Design Engineer
jobs.description_text: About this Role We are building a Group 5 autonomous aircraft and driving it to first flight. We are in detailed design with tooling in work, and we are looking for a structures design engineer to own parts on that aircraft from concept through first article. You will design and size real hardware: control surfaces, ribs and spars, frames, doors and access panels, fittings and joints. You will take your parts all the way out, through analysis, drawings, vendor coordination, first article, and the fixes that come after. Our structures lead sets the architecture and the design approach. Inside that, your parts are yours. This is a role for someone who wants to design more and coordinate less. You will be in CAD and in FEA most days, and in the shop the rest of them. The aircraft is small enough as an organization that the person who draws a part is the person who sees it come off the tool, and finds out the same week whether the call they made was right. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Own structural design and sizing for primary and secondary airframe structure, including wing, fuselage, empennage, and major joints - Develop the loads and criteria set for the aircraft and turn it into sized structure with documented margins - Run static, buckling, fatigue, and dynamic analysis in FEA, and know when hand calcs are the faster and better answer - Design in composites and metallics, and make the call on which belongs where based on weight, cost, and rate - Work directly with manufacturing on lay

In this role, you'll be responsible for ensuring the structural integrity and safety of our vehicle designs through comprehensive analysis, testing, and validation. This position offers the opportunity to shape both individual designs and company-wide standards, taking projects from initial concept through regulatory certification. You’ll own the electrical and electronic systems that make the aircraft fly: sensors, flight computers, radios, power, and the harnesses that tie it all together. You’ll work day to day with our embedded software team, but your focus is the hardware: integrating it, testing it, breaking it on the bench, and getting it ready for the aircraft. This role is a fit for someone early in their career who has crossed the line between mechanical and electrical engineering, whether that’s an ME who kept ending up in the wiring or an EE who kept ending up in the airframe. If you’ve built and flown something, you’ll feel at home here. As part of our imaging team in Tampere, you will help test and characterize the camera modules going into our current and next-generation products, design the lab setups that make that testing possible, and — depending on your interests — get involved in image quality analysis, ISP tuning, or our Qualcomm-based camera software stack. This is a part-time position alongside your studies, with flexible hours. ABOUT THE TEAM: We design camera systems that support autonomous navigation, professional media capture, and industrial inspection and situational awareness. From early-stage user needs analysis to mass production, we manage the entire lifecycle: requirements definition, hardware bring-up, tuning, and validation. jobs.description_text: About the Team: Public safety is where drone technology faces the highest stakes. Agencies across the country are standing up Drone as First Responder (DFR) programs that put an aircraft over an emergency within seconds of a call. As drone programs move from the age of tools to the age of infrastructure, we are expanding our public safety sales team to meet that demand. About the role: As a Key Account Director, Corrections at Skydio, you will lead a national team of Key Account Leaders selling into State Departments of Corrections and state-funded Port Authorities. This is a first-line leadership role, and the job comes down to three things: recruiting the right people, coaching them into great sellers, and keeping them here. You will not carry your own accounts. Your number is your team’s number, and you will hit it by making each person on the team better: sharpening deal strategy, getting into the field on their most competitive pursuits, and building the territory, pipeline, and forecast discipline that makes a segment predictable. You will work alongside peer Directors leading other segments and geographies, and across Channel, Sales Engineering, Business Development, Marketing, Strategic Relationships, Government Relations, and Mission Success. Corrections is one of our least penetrated markets, so building the Skydio brand with DOC leadership is part of the job alongside building the team. You will also set the standard for how the team works, not only what it sells.

jobs.title: Field Support Representative - Virginia
jobs.description_text: About the role: As a Skydio products ambassador, you will work in a small team of high-performing individuals who provide UAS system and Cloud operational best practices and deep feature diagnostics to Skydio’s utility and commercial customers, along with state and local government agencies. You’ll combine your UAS experience, ideally gained inside or alongside an electric, gas, or energy utility, with hands-on Skydio product knowledge to provide best-in-class onsite and remote technical and logistics support, help keep utility pilots and inspection programs flying, and keep our engineering and marketing teams plugged into the customer experience. You’ll work both remotely and at customer sites such as substations, transmission and distribution corridors, and generation facilities, performing device firmware troubleshooting, inspection mission configuration and optimization, and 1st / 3rd party cloud network optimization and issue diagnostics. Using log analysis tools, customer incident tickets, and internal documentation, you will determine the root cause of flight and skill issues (e.g., media streaming, 3D scan, automated inspection workflows), provide mitigation recommendations to customers, and collaborate with product teams to drive product enhancements. By owning customer relationships in the field and collecting feedback, you will be a trusted partner and liaison between Skydio Program Management, Product, Support, and Engineering teams. You'll join a Revenue Operations team that has built the core routing, enrichment, and funnel infrastructure, and you'll have room to improve each of them. Because marketing systems feed directly into the sales process, you'll also partner with Sales and BDR teams on Salesforce work that keeps pipeline moving, and help harden routing, enrichment, and data hygiene alongside the rest of RevOps. This role is built for someone who ramps fast and runs independently. With documented systems and SOPs to lean on, you'll be expected to own your queue within your first 30–45 days and make sound calls without waiting for sign-off. Your mission is to evolve this architecture so that open, multi-format data lakes are not just searchable by humans, but inherently AI-ready by transforming interoperable metadata into the contextual engine that powers agentic innovation. jobs.description_text: We are looking for talented systems developers and researchers to join the Snowflake AI Research team and advance the state of the art in LLM inference systems and optimization. Our mission is to build the next generation of high-performance and intelligent inference systems. We optimize not only how fast and efficiently models run, but also how quickly inference systems can adapt to new models, architectures, hardware, and workloads. Our work spans the full inference stack—from distributed serving and runtime systems to GPU kernels and model-system co-design. We explore techniques such as adaptive parallelism, speculative and parallel decoding, disaggregated inference, scheduling and batching, KV-cache optimization, model swapping, quantization, and GPU kernel optimization to push the frontier of latency, throughput, scalability, and cost. Beyond optimizing individual models, we are building intelligent and adaptive inference systems that can automate performance optimization—rapidly profiling new models and workloads, identifying bottlenecks, selecting effective execution strategies, and adapting system configurations with minimal manual tuning. We embrace AI-native engineering, using AI not only as the workload we optimize, but also as a tool to accelerate system development, experimentation, debugging, optimization, and adaptation to new models. This role is a unique opportunity to make a significant impact by building a flexible, large scale, high-performance, and resilient platform for Snowlake features and services. Be part of the vision to create the best data cloud platform. Our ‘get it done’ culture allows everyone at Snowflake to have an equal opportunity to innovate on new ideas, create work with a lasting impact, and excel in a culture of collaboration. AS A SENIOR TECHNICAL PROGRAM MANAGER, YOU WILL: - Be responsible for defining and delivering important programs with broad organizational, business and technical impact. - Provide cross-functional leadership with Engineering and Product Management, and inter/intra team communications to deliver outstanding program outcomes. - Bring strong, data-driven and strategic technical judgment to decisions. - Be hands-on, working closely with Software Engineers and Product Managers to design, build, and deliver the next generation of Snowflake services and apps. - Amplify your impact by educating and mentoring the TPM and Engineering communities on program management best practices. - Identify opportunities to improve execution of the organization as a whole, to increase engineering productivity through tools and light-weight processes. jobs.title: Senior Solution Engineer, Financial Services
jobs.description_text: We are looking for a Senior Solution Engineer who is accustomed to solving customer’s most complex problems and closing large deals. In this role you will work directly with the sales team and channel partners to understand the needs of our customers, strategize on how to navigate winning sales cycles, provide compelling value-based demonstrations, support enterprise Proof of Concepts, and ultimately close business. As a Snowflake Solution Engineer you must share our passion about reinventing the database space, thrive in a dynamic environment and have the flexibility and willingness to jump in and get things done. You are equally comfortable in both a business and technical context, interacting with executives and talking shop with technical audiences. jobs.title: Senior Social Media Manager, Developer Community
jobs.description_text: Snowflake is experiencing exponential growth and we’re looking for a seasoned Senior Social Media Manager to elevate its social media profile among the global developer community. This individual will be a steward of the Snowflake’s developer social presence, specifically responsible for engaging technical audiences. This role is critical to reinforce Snowflake’s AI Data Cloud vision and business momentum by showcasing technical innovation and value to developers. This role demands a dynamic social media expert with a background in running presences for established B2B brands who can develop, execute, and measure the impact of owned, paid and earned social media. The ideal candidate is comfortable operating in a high-growth environment, is AI-minded, and possesses a strong knack for innovative content creation. They are also a dedicated team-player, proactive, and highly organized, with a talent to build collaborative relationships with key stakeholders. This person will work closely with cross-functional teams including PR, Product Marketing, Developer Relations, Developer Advocacy, and the broader Marketing and Global Communications teams to create plans that drive awareness and engagement with our key audiences. They will be responsible for overall program management, inclusive of content creation, reporting, and creating operational efficiencies to ensure we’re structured to scale the practice to support Snowflake’s expansive business.
